Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنَ المُتَوَكِّلِينَ عَلَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, make me among those who rely upon You in this day
And make me among those who are successful with You
And make me among those who are brought near to You
By Your favor, O Ultimate Goal of those who seek
